answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mesa of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the cedar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the juniper of the next round. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short.
